title: spawnSyncNodeShaped uses `raw.exitCode ?? 1` as a defensive fallback, but per t…
body: spawnSyncNodeShaped uses `raw.exitCode ?? 1` as a defensive fallback, but per the Bun docs SyncSubprocess.exitCode is typed `number` (non-null); the `?? 1` is harmless dead-defense. Left as-is is fine given signal-termination runtime nullability, but worth a one-line note if kept.
